description: Add cursor-based pagination to getDataByCategory to prevent unbounded data fetches

tasks.title: Implement cursor encoding/decoding utilities
tasks.description: Add private methods to encode/decode cursor from recordedAt + id

modification_points.description: Add cursor utility methods to service class

implementation: Add encodeCursor method: private encodeCursor(recordedAt: Date, id: string): string { return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ t: recordedAt.toISOString(), i: id })).toString('base64url') }

Add decodeCursor method: private decodeCursor(cursor: string): { recordedAt: Date, id: string } | null { try { const { t, i } = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cursor, 'base64url').toString()); return { recordedAt: new Date(t), id: i }; } catch { return null; } }
Use base64url encoding for URL-safe cursors
Handle invalid cursor gracefully by returning null

Test decodeCursor reverses encodeCursor correctly

tasks.title: Refactor getDataByCategory with pagination
tasks.description: Update getDataByCategory to accept pagination params and return paginated results

modification_points.description: Refactor getDataByCategory method signature and implementation

implementation: Update method signature: async getDataByCategory(categoryKey: string, start: Date, end: Date, granularity?: string, pagination?: PaginationInput): Promise<PaginatedResult<EconomicDataPoint>>
Apply limit with default: const limit = Math.min(pagination?.limit ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_LIMIT, MAX_PAGE_LIMIT)
If cursor provided, decode and add to where clause: cursor: { recordedAt_id: { recordedAt: decoded.recordedAt, id: decoded.id } }
Fetch limit + 1 to determine hasMore
Build pagination meta: { hasMore: points.length > limit, nextCursor: hasMore ? encodeCursor(lastPoint) : undefined }
Return { data: points.slice(0, limit), pagination }
Maintain backward compatibility: if no pagination param, return legacy format

Build aggregation query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC(granularity, recordedAt) as bucket, AVG(value) as value, COUNT(*) as count FROM EconomicDataPoint WHERE ... GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
